marco-cust: Quick check - we need BYOK backed by customer CloudHSM, 4h KEK rotation, and per-key audit lines for SOC2. Our game backend needs ~12ms p50 token latency. Can Redwood prove this in a short POC?
ella-sales: yes, we can run a 3-week POC. Two main architectures to validate: sidecar key-proxy (fast) or direct KMS unwraps (strict). We'll map cost in the SOW.
diego-se: tech note: sidecar trades memory surface for latency. Example knobs we'll test: cache_ttl (seconds), max_cached_keys, mem_lock. With cache_ttl=60s sidecar usually keeps p50 low.
diego-se: sample perf command we'll run in POC: `./perf-run --qps 200 --cache-ttl 60 --rotate-cron "0 */4 * * *"` to measure unwraps/sec and p50.
rachel-sec: auditors will want HSM attestation PDF, key provenance, signed proof-of-possession, and immutable audit lines (wrap/unwrap, key_id, ts, principal). We provide schema and example files.
marco-cust: can you paste one audit sample we can drop into Splunk?
diego-se: single-line example: {"ts":"2026-07-14T16:05:12Z","event":"unwrap","key_id":"cust/prod/kek01","req":"r_42","svc":"match-svc"}
ella-sales: POC plan (3 weeks): kickoff & FW/attest exchange, deploy sidecar in staging + small perf run, rotation stress (4h cadence x72h), deliver logs + cost delta, go/no-go.
ella-sales: action items: @diego-se perf harness and dashboard, @rachel-sec attach attestation sample + log schema, @marco-cust confirm peak QPS and whether FIPS is required.
deploy-bot: deploy: key-proxy v0.9 staged to stg-3 at 2026-07-14T16:20:05Z :white_check_mark:
marco-cust: thanks all — if sidecar with cache_ttl=60s hits ~12ms p50 and auditors get attestation + logs, we'll sign the SOW. :thumbsup:
